heading: Gang investigation coordination and information collection

tree.heading: Coordination
tree.text: The Attorney General (or the Attorney General’s designee), in consultation with the Secretary of the Treasury (or the Secretary’s designee), shall develop a national strategy to coordinate gang-related investigations by Federal law enforcement agencies.

tree.heading: Data collection
tree.text: The Director of the Federal Bureau of Investigation shall acquire and collect information on incidents of gang violence for inclusion in an annual uniform crime report.

tree.heading: Report
tree.text: The Attorney General shall prepare a report on national gang violence outlining the strategy developed under subsection (a) to be submitted to the President and Congress by January 1, 1996.

tree.heading: Authorization of appropriations
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated to carry out this section $1,000,000 for fiscal year 1996.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 14062 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
